note: osqlWherePredicate(where, columns) lowered per dialect by tools/ir-osql-where-pairs.mjs over the columns below; a port must give the same {sql, params} bytes, or the same error. {every: true} is no condition. BETWEEN renders as (>= AND <=), as the ranges do. An INTEGER is inlined after its range check; a packed value is bound as a decimal string. Blanks are space, tab, CR and LF only. Limits: nesting depth 256, comparisons 2000. Refusal reasons are the closed list in REASONS.

pairs.name: a column name in any case
a CHAR literal cut to the column's length
a doubled quote is one quote
a decimal against a packed column
every comparison
pairs.where: seatsmax < 1 OR seatsmax > 2 OR seatsmax <= 3 OR seatsmax >= 4 OR seatsmax <> 5

pairs.name: NOT ( ... ), as the producers write it
a quoted literal into STRING drops trailing blanks (ABAP's C to STRING)
a backtick literal into STRING keeps them
an INT4 literal rounds half away from zero
an INT4 literal rounds down below the half
an empty literal against INT4 is 0
a packed literal rounds to the column's decimals
a packed literal is bound as a decimal string
a date cut to eight characters
a date with dashes is cut, not read
a trailing blank in a LIKE pattern on CHAR
a CHAR literal is cut in UTF-16 units
the three producers: a SADL key
the three producers: the search help, in lower case
the three producers: SE16, a negated pattern
a select-options group as the request context writes it
pairs.where: ( CARRID = 'LH' OR CARRID = 'AA' ) AND ( NOT ( SEATSMAX > 300 ) )

pairs.name: a literal on the left is semantics
an operator not between blanks is syntax
an escaped host variable is semantics
ESCAPE with a wildcard is semantics
text against INT4 is a dump
an exponent against INT4 is a dump
past the packed digits is a dump
an unterminated literal is malformed, not measured
a sign on both sides is a format not measured
a no-break space is not a blank
nesting past the limit is refused
a column against a column is refused
an unquoted number against CHAR is refused
a NUMC literal that is not digits is refused
